_help: Words and phrases that can't be used in a Top 100 name or town. Lower case, one per line.
The checker ignores capitals and accents, sees through common tricks (f.u.c.k, fuuuck, sh1t, $hit,
look-alike letters from other alphabets) and also catches a plural 's' on the end.
words:    blocked as a whole word only, so 'cunt' doesn't block Scunthorpe. Use this for most entries.
anywhere: blocked even inside another word, e.g. 'fuck' also blocks 'fuckface'.
Only put a word here if no real name or place contains it.
editions: extra 'words' and 'anywhere' lists for one edition only (rival clubs, sectarian terms).
After changing this file, commit and deploy. The board is re-checked every time it loads, so
existing entries that use a newly banned word disappear straight away (they stay in the database
and show as 'blocked' on the Top 100 admin page).
